title: Version history has no date-range filter or search — flat accordion list; certifications with many versions require scrolling through all recent entries; violates ISO 27001:2022 Clause 7.5
statusRaw: VersionHistory.jsx is dead code — never imported or rendered anywhere in the app (confirmed while working TV-023, which targets the same file). No live screen exists to add a date-range filter to, so this is won't-fix until/unless the component is wired up for real.
description:
Files: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/trust-vault/VersionHistory.jsx

Root Cause: Flat accordion list with no filtering or search. Certifications with many versions require scrolling through all entries to find a specific date range.

Claude Fix Prompt: Add `<DateRangePicker value={dateRange} onChange={setDateRange} />` above the version list. Filter displayed versions: `const filteredVersions = dateRange ? versions.filter(v => isWithinInterval(new Date(v.createdAt), dateRange)) : versions;`. Add search by `changedBy` name: `<Input placeholder="Search by reviewer..." value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} />`.

title: `customLabel` field has no length validation — `TrustNetworkSharingPanel` Input has no `maxLength` attribute; excessively long labels overflow partner-facing views
statusRaw: Already fixed in the live code — the customLabel Input in TrustNetworkSharingPanel.jsx already has maxLength={100}, a live 'X/100' counter, and a >100-char rejection check in handleSave. No code change was needed; verified by reading the current file.
description: Files: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/trust-vault/TrustNetworkSharingPanel.jsx Root Cause: `customLabel` Input has no `maxLength` attribute and no Yup validation. Excessively long labels overflow partner-facing shared views. Claude Fix Prompt: Add `maxLength={80}` to the Input. Add Yup validation: `customLabel: Yup.string().max(80, 'Custom label must be 80 characters or fewer').optional()`. Add character counter: `{customLabel.length}/80`.

title: `visibleToPartners` count not clickable in `VaultHealthWidget` — "Visible to N partners" rendered as plain text; no navigation shortcut to Trust Network settings or partner list; violates Annex A 5.14
description:
Files: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/trust-vault/VaultHealthWidget.jsx

Root Cause: "Visible to N partners" rendered as plain text with no link or navigation shortcut to Trust Network settings or the partner list.

Claude Fix Prompt: Wrap in `<Link href="/trust-vault/settings/trust-network">`: `<Link href="/trust-vault/settings/trust-network" className="text-sm text-primary hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"><Users className="w-4 h-4" />Visible to {visibleToPartners} partners<ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3" /></Link>`.

title: `publicSummary` Textarea has no character counter or maximum length enforcement — `IncidentForm` shows placeholder text only; no `maxLength`; no minimum content warning when `trustNetworkEnabled` is false; single-character entry valid; violates Annex A 5.26
statusRaw: FIXED — verified 2026-09-02. IncidentForm.jsx's publicSummary Textarea now has maxLength={500}, and the counter is always visible: X/50 toward the sharing minimum when trustNetworkEnabled is on, X/500 toward the cap otherwise.
description:
Files: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/trust-vault/IncidentForm.jsx Root Cause: `publicSummary` Textarea shows placeholder text only. No `maxLength`, no character counter, no minimum content warning when `trustNetworkEnabled` is active. Claude Fix Prompt: Add `maxLength={500}` to Textarea. Display counter: `{publicSummary.length}/500`. When `trustNetworkEnabled`: `{publicSummary.length < 50 &&

Minimum 50 characters required when sharing with partners ({50 - publicSummary.length} more needed)

}`.
fixEvidence: `IncidentForm.jsx` — `maxLength={500}` on the Textarea, counter always rendered (X/50 when sharing enabled, X/500 otherwise), confirmed on 2026-09-02 (client-panel HEAD 0b8712ce). No regression found.
